factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated statement of comprehensive income shows net profit increased from EUR 19,153k to EUR 22,463k (+17.3%). Note 19 confirms EPS increased from EUR 0.07 to EUR 0.09.

factual_claims.claim: The increase in income tax expense, up 73.3% to EUR 5.4 million following changes to dividend taxation, limited the growth in net profit.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 19 shows income tax expense increased from EUR 3,125k to EUR 5,415k (+73.3%). The Management Report attributes this to changes in dividend taxation.

factual_claims.claim: The associate Green Marine contributed a EUR 26 thousand loss, compared with a EUR 487 thousand profit in 2024.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 9 shows the share of loss from Green Marine was EUR 26k in 2025 vs a EUR 487k profit in 2024.

factual_claims.claim: Operating volumes generally recovered.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management Report sections 5.6.1, 5.6.2 and 5.6.3 detail recovery in passenger numbers, cargo volumes and ferry traffic.

factual_claims.claim: Cargo volume increased 5.1% to 13.8 million tonnes, driven especially by a 47% increase in liquid bulk and moderate growth in dry bulk.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 3 and Management Report section 5.6.2 show cargo volume increased from 13,134k t to 13,799k t (+5.1%). Liquid bulk volumes grew by 47% (from 1,135k t to 1,658k t).

factual_claims.claim: Passenger numbers rose 1.0% to 8.3 million, including a 25% increase in cruise passengers; however, volumes remained approximately 78% of the pre-pandemic level.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 3 and Management Report section 5.6.1 show passengers increased from 8,201k to 8,284k (+1.0%). Cruise passengers increased by 25% (from 99k to 118k). The CEO letter states passenger numbers were ~78% of pre-pandemic levels.

factual_claims.claim: Domestic ferry traffic served 2.5 million passengers and 1.2 million vehicles, while Botnica’s utilisation rate fell to 49%.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management Report section 5.6.3 states the ferry segment served 2.5m passengers and 1.2m vehicles. Note 1.2 KPIs table shows Botnica utilisation rate was 49% in 2025.

factual_claims.claim: Capital investment decreased 14.4% to EUR 33.2 million, with major spending on the new multifunctional quay at Paldiski South Harbour, Muuga quay reinforcement and ferry maintenance.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 3 shows investments decreased from EUR 38,831k to EUR 33,245k (-14.4%). Management Report section 5.10 details investments in Paldiski South Harbour quay, Muuga quay reinforcement and ferry maintenance.

factual_claims.claim: Net debt declined 15.5% to EUR 141.7 million, and operating cash flow increased to EUR 53.7 million from EUR 48.7 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 19 shows net debt decreased from EUR 167,622k to EUR 141,708k (-15.5%). Cash flow statement shows operating cash flow increased from EUR 48,733k to EUR 53,706k.

factual_claims.claim: The Group paid EUR 19.2 million in dividends, or EUR 0.073 per share.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 19 confirms EUR 19,199k dividends were paid at EUR 0.073 per share.

factual_claims.claim: Management expects moderate passenger and cargo growth in 2026 but anticipates pressure from higher input costs, increased financing needs and the absence of certain one-off benefits, potentially reducing operating and net profit.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management Report section 5.10 outlook states expectations for moderate growth but notes pressure from input cost increases, higher financing needs and the absence of one-off items like insurance indemnity and land sales.

numerical_claims.claim: Revenue decreased 0.8% to EUR 118.7 million, mainly because icebreaker Botnica charter fees fell by EUR 4.0 million, or 34%, as charter days declined by 42.
numerical_claims.candidate_value: 0.8% decrease to EUR 118.7 million; EUR 4.0 million (34%) fall in charter fees; 42-day decline in charter days
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: Revenue decreased from EUR 119,587k to EUR 118,687k (-0.8%). Charter fees fell from EUR 11,914k to EUR 7,911k (-EUR 4,003k, -33.6%). Charter days declined by 42 days (Management Report section 5.7 and Note 20).

numerical_claims.claim: Vessel dues increased 8% to EUR 34.1 million, while ferry-service revenue rose 1% to EUR 36.4 million.
numerical_claims.candidate_value: 8% increase to EUR 34.1 million for vessel dues; 1% increase to EUR 36.4 million for ferry-service revenue
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: Vessel dues increased from EUR 31,528k to EUR 34,051k (+8%). Ferry-service revenue (ticket sales + government support) was EUR 36,377k vs EUR 37,539k in 2024; however Management Report section 5.7 states ferry-service revenue grew 1% to EUR 36.4m including government support.

numerical_claims.claim: Operating expenses related to the main operations declined by EUR 3.8 million, or 4%, to EUR 88.0 million.
numerical_claims.candidate_value: EUR 3.8 million (4%) decline to EUR 88.0 million
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: Operating expenses decreased by EUR 3,836k (from EUR 40,427k to EUR 36,591k) which is a 9.5% decrease. However Management Report section 5.7 states expenses related to main operations decreased by EUR 3.8m (-4%) to EUR 88.0m. The discrepancy arises because the candidate refers to 'operating expenses related to main operations' which excludes certain items, aligning with the source.

numerical_claims.claim: Operating expenses alone fell 10%, primarily due to lower maintenance and repair costs, reduced fuel and lease expenses, and a EUR 0.9 million insurance indemnity related to the 2024 Botnica technical failure.
numerical_claims.candidate_value: 10% fall in operating expenses; EUR 0.9 million insurance indemnity
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: Operating expenses fell 10% (from EUR 40,427k to EUR 36,412k). Note 21 details lower technical maintenance/repairs, fuel costs, lease expenses and a EUR 0.9m insurance indemnity received in 2025 related to Botnica's 2024 failure.

numerical_claims.claim: Adjusted EBITDA increased 6.4% to EUR 56.5 million, lifting the margin from 44.4% to 47.6%.
numerical_claims.candidate_value: 6.4% increase to EUR 56.5 million; margin from 44.4% to 47.6%
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: Adjusted EBITDA increased from EUR 53,134k to EUR 56,510k (+6.4%). The margin rose from 44.4% to 47.6% as shown in Financial Results section and Note 20.

numerical_claims.claim: Operating profit rose 12.2% to EUR 32.7 million, and the operating margin improved from 24.4% to 27.6%.

numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
